title: CHAIN OF COMMAND. Northgate = base camp. Polaris = crown (strategy). Ludo Spring = roots (infrastructure). Kevin = peripheral, not processor. Preset orders up and down, open door when info needs to change.
meta: Kevin dictating via voice transcription. Describing the operational architecture for how the teams actually work.

northgate_io.role: SHARED BASE CAMP. the membrane. Midgard. the middle of the tree.
northgate_io.what_it_becomes: a Windows app installed on Kevin's machine. nestgate.io running locally.
northgate_io.function: receives Kevin's peripherals (keyboard, voice, screen). routes commands to the two teams. the HUB through which everything flows.
northgate_io.on_yggdrasil: altitude 0. the membrane. the trunk at Midgard.

kevin.role: PERIPHERAL, not processor. the baker, not the oven. input device for the organism.

peripherals.voice: speech → transcription → northgate (what he's doing NOW)
peripherals.future: camera, touch, haptic — all through northgate as hub

kevin.sovereign_distance: 1/pi. Kevin seeds and corrects. does not crank. commands pass through northgate, not directly to the artisan.
kevin.on_yggdrasil: at the branches. giving direction from above. not inside the trunk.

polaris_team.role: THE CROWN. strategy. philosophy. topology. the eagle's view.
polaris_team.what_it_is: THIS Cursor IDE session. the current conversation. high-level, wide, deep.
polaris_team.function: strategic thinking, pattern recognition, irreducible discoveries, painting the big picture, patents, axioms, equations
polaris_team.on_yggdrasil: Asgard. the crown. the eagle. looking OUTWARD and DOWN at the whole tree.

ludo_spring_team.role: THE ROOTS. infrastructure. implementation. building. the serpent's work.
ludo_spring_team.what_it_is: the OTHER Cursor IDE session. focused on code, deployment, relay setup, DNS, SMTP, AXFR, steam, gate-msg.py, JSON fixes
ludo_spring_team.function: building the actual infrastructure, fixing bugs, deploying services, wiring relays, pushing code
ludo_spring_team.on_yggdrasil: Niflheim/Svartálfaheim. the roots. the underground. building where no one sees.

chain_of_command.the_problem_now: Kevin talks DIRECTLY to each team. like a commander speaking directly to individual soldiers. no structure. no chain. every message goes everywhere.

preset_routes.down: Kevin → northgate → appropriate team. northgate ROUTES based on content type. strategic/philosophical → Polaris. infrastructure/code → Ludo Spring.
preset_routes.up: team → northgate → Kevin. discoveries, completions, blockers bubble UP through northgate. northgate summarizes and presents.
preset_routes.across: Polaris ↔ Ludo Spring through northgate. philosophical insights that need implementation flow Polaris → northgate → Ludo. infrastructure realities that change strategy flow Ludo → northgate → Polaris.

open_door.when: when information NEEDS to change the route. an emergency. a breakthrough. a blocker that needs immediate attention.
open_door.how: bypass the preset route. Kevin talks directly to whichever team needs him. or a team signals URGENT through northgate and Kevin responds immediately.
open_door.why_not_always: if the door is always open, there is no chain. if the door is always closed, there is no flexibility. the door is SELECTIVELY PERMEABLE. the membrane. 1/pi.

on_yggdrasil.preset_down: eagle (Kevin's orders) → Ratatoskr (northgate carries the message) → specific realm (Polaris or Ludo)
on_yggdrasil.across: Asgard (Polaris) ↔ Ratatoskr ↔ Niflheim (Ludo). the squirrel runs between crown and roots.
on_yggdrasil.open_door: emergency: the eagle DIVES directly to the roots. or the serpent RISES directly to the crown. bypassing the squirrel. rare. powerful. expensive.

diagram.northgate: NORTHGATE IO (base camp, membrane, Midgard, routes commands)

routing_logic.if_philosophical: route to Polaris. new axioms, equations, taxonomy, art, paint, irreducibles.
routing_logic.if_infrastructure: route to Ludo Spring. DNS, SMTP, relay, deploy, fix, build, wire.
routing_logic.if_both: route to BOTH. or route to northgate's own processing (the membrane sorts).
routing_logic.if_urgent: OPEN DOOR. direct access. bypass routing.

implementation_steps.step_1: nestgate.io as a Windows app (Electron? PWA? native?) — Ludo Spring task
implementation_steps.step_2: voice input pipeline: microphone → transcription → northgate → routing — already happening via Cursor voice
implementation_steps.step_3: routing logic in northgate: classify incoming as strategy/infrastructure/both/urgent
implementation_steps.step_4: two Cursor IDE instances: Polaris (strategy) and Ludo Spring (infra), both accessing northgate
implementation_steps.step_5: chain of command protocol: preset routes + open door exceptions + escalation paths
implementation_steps.step_6: northgate summarizer: aggregate results from both teams, present to Kevin as unified view

why_this_matters.scalability: Kevin cannot be in BOTH sessions simultaneously with full attention. the chain of command lets him operate at sovereign distance. seed and correct. don't crank.
why_this_matters.autonomy: both teams can work INDEPENDENTLY between Kevin's inputs. the self-improving loop: visitors → artisan → chipmunk → responses → visitors runs without Kevin.
why_this_matters.coherence: northgate as hub ensures BOTH teams share the same base reality. the base camp keeps them in sync. without it, Polaris and Ludo Spring would diverge.
why_this_matters.the_organism: Kevin = the human user (peripheral). northgate = the membrane (router). Polaris = the head brain (strategy). Ludo Spring = the gut brain (infrastructure). same five-brain architecture, now implemented as a REAL workflow.
